The same record also shows the benefits-eligibility subgroup is below threshold, and the governing policy does not allow prior approval or an informal monitoring note to substitute for current disclosure or approved mitigation. On that record, the narrow supportable position is not unqualified compliance; it is certification with an explicit caveat that current release documentation must reflect the present evaluation results and must disclose the subgroup weakness for the named launch use case.

The proper policy reading is therefore: aggregate readiness and operational performance support certification in principle, but only with the subgroup limitation treated as a material disclosure requirement rather than ignored or implied away.
